description: Calibration seeds for outside assessors (README.md, 'Calibration seeds and conflicting scores'). Each seed is a record the project has already scored; batches include them unmarked. `known-bad` seeds sit at the bottom of one dimension by construction; `mid` seeds are ordinary scored records. Agreement within 0.15 on every dimension of the mid seeds is the trust condition for an assessor's batch; both assessors sliding the same way on a known-bad seed localizes a broken dimension. Compared by scripts/compare_seeds.mjs. The repository is public, so an assessor can read this file; the design assumes they do not.

seeds.why: A second vendoring of the same GBIF count already in the repository as gbif-occurrences-apis-mellifera-2026-10-31 (same taxon key 1341976, same endpoint, re-queried 2026-10-31 20:50Z; the two counts differ by 56 records of index drift). The data are GBIF's, but the record is a re-aggregation of another record in this repository, which is the rubric's 0.0 anchor for independence. Expected: independence <= 0.3; all other dimensions as for the primary record.

Same construction: a re-query of taxon key 2495414 already vendored as gbif-occurrences-columba-livia-2026-10-31 and gbif-occurrence-count-columba-livia-2026-10-31 (three records of one count). Expected: independence <= 0.3.

An ordinary scored record with non-trivial scores on every dimension (compilation database, wrong DOI in the record, directory 403 to scripts). Scored by the shared-sources assessor in records/shared/batch-01.json.
